name: Picture
brief: Picture class for loading and displaying images and vector graphics

members.name: accessible
description: In accessible mode the picture retains an internal map of ID-accessible asset nodes (such as named SVG nodes), which makes `paint` lookups more efficient and is required for `Accessor.name()` to resolve names.

members.name: resolver
members.brief: Set a resolver for external assets (images, fonts) referenced by the picture.
description: Set this BEFORE calling `load` — the resolver runs during load, once per external reference, and setting it afterwards has no effect on assets that were already resolved. Pass `null` to remove a previously set resolver.

members.name: load
members.signature: load(data: Uint8Array | string, options: LoadDataOptions = {}): this
members.brief: Load picture from raw data (Uint8Array or string for SVG)

params.name: data
params.description: Raw image data as Uint8Array or SVG string

members.name: size
members.brief: Set the size of the picture (scales it)

members.name: size
members.brief: Get the current size of the picture

members.name: size
members.signature: size(width?: number, height?: number): this | PictureSize

members.name: paint
members.brief: Retrieve a paint object from this picture's scene tree by ID.

params.name: id
params.description: A numeric hash ID or a string name (which will be hashed via Accessor.id)

members.returns: The matching Paint object, or null if not found

members.name: filter
members.brief: Set the image filtering method used when this picture is scaled or transformed.

params.name: method
params.description: The filtering method to apply (default: FilterMethod.Bilinear)
